title: End-to-End Dense Video Grounding via Parallel Regression

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: In this paper, we tackle a new problem of dense video grounding, by simultaneously localizing multiple moments with a paragraph as input.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Thanks to its simplicity in design, our PRVG framework can be applied in different testing schemes (sparse or dense grounding) and allows for efficient inference without any post-processing technique.

problems.name: Query Ambiguity, Invalid Queries, and Open-Set Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Different from traditional computer vision tasks in video understanding such as action recognition (Tran et al., 2015; Wang et al., 2016) and temporal action localization (Lin et al., 2018; Tan et al., 2021), which are limited to pre-defined actions, VG allows for an open set of activities with language as queries.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Existing methods often address this task in an indirect way, by casting it as a proposal-and-match or fusion-and-detection problem.
